item.stem:
In a class in Kochi, Meera and Arjun list four activities. In which activities does the observation show that matter is made of extremely small particles and does not become nothing?

| activity | W | X | Y | Z |
| activity | grinding a piece of chalk into fine powder | burning a piece of paper to ash | water evaporating from a hot plate | dissolving a spoon of salt in water |
| observation | the powder still tastes and behaves like chalk | only ash and smoke remain | the water seems to disappear completely | the water tastes salty, so the salt is still present |
